Amanda: Heads-up — starting bring-up for an ensemble reranker setup: BM25 candidate generation -> quantized neural reranker (int8) as expensive stage. We have a hard p99 SLO of 120ms for the endpoint. Need an evaluation protocol to trade off quality (NDCG@10 / MRR) vs latency/cost. Ideas?
Jason: I would simulate cascades offline first. Replay production query stream against BM25 + measure which queries actually hit the neural stage under different thresholds, then add modeled neural latency. That gives an approximate p99.
Leila: Important — int8 can shift scores. Include a golden subset (human labels) to ensure no big calibration regressions. Also slice by doc length and popularity (tail vs head).
Oliver: Think in terms of a quality-latency curve: sweep cascade thresholds, plot NDCG@10 vs p99 latency. We can summarize with area-under-curve or a costed-NDCG where we subtract alpha * latency_ms.
Jason: Quick offline command prototype: 
```
rerank_eval.py --dataset=prod-replay-2026 --candidates=bm25 --reranker=model-v2-quant-int8 \
  --cascade-config="bm25_topk=200;nn_thresholds=[0.1,0.2,0.3]" \
  --metrics="ndcg@10,mrr" --simulate-latency --replay-threads=64
```
Leila: Sample size note: need ~10k unique queries per configuration to estimate ndcg deltas reliably. Use bootstrap (1000 resamples) to get CIs and run paired tests (e.g., Wilcoxon) for significance. Also set a guardrail: no golden-query NDCG drop > 0.01.
Amanda: For the cascade policy, do we prefer score gap threshold vs top-k cutoff? Which is more stable with quantized scores?
Oliver: Score-gap is fragile under quantization noise. I suggest a hybrid: top-k cap (e.g., 50–200) + a conservative score-gap. This keeps tail queries from doing unnecessary NN work while avoiding small score jitters triggering extra runs. Log the number of NN calls per million queries.
Jason: Also measure end-to-end token cost: tokens_in * per-token GPU cost + overhead. That helps with Dedicated capacity sizing.
Leila: For stats: produce per-query pair (ndcg_fullNN, ndcg_cascade) so we can compute deltas and rank queries by delta. That helps find pathological slices (long docs, non-English, sparse clicks).
deploy-bot: eval-runner: started job rerank-cascade-sweep #342 (ETA ~2h) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Amanda: Sweet — assign to Jason for replay infra, Leila for golden set & stats, Oliver for costed-NDCG metric code. Please drop outputs in /shared/benchmarks/rerank/cascade-1752468000 and ping here. Thanks :thumbsup:
